assistantWelcome: Hello! I am your Smart Tourist Safety Assistant. You can ask me about travel safety, emergency preparedness and general safety tips. How can I help you?
suggestionTravelSafety: How can I stay safe while travelling?
suggestionEmergency: What should I do during an emergency?
suggestionUnsafeLocation: How can I identify an unsafe location?
suggestionSoloTravel: Give me some solo travel safety tips.
assistantEmergencyResponse: If you are in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Move to a safe and public location if possible, share your location with a trusted contact, and use the SOS feature in the application. Never wait for an AI response before seeking emergency help.
assistantSoloTravelResponse: For solo travel, share your itinerary with someone you trust, keep your phone charged, use well-lit public routes, verify your accommodation and avoid sharing live travel details with strangers.
assistantLocationResponse: Before visiting an unfamiliar location, check local safety advisories, recent reports, lighting, public transport access and nearby emergency services. This demo cannot verify the live safety status of any location.
assistantTravelResponse: Plan your route in advance, prefer well-lit and populated roads, keep your navigation active and share your trip details with a trusted contact. Live route risk analysis will be integrated later.
assistantDefaultResponse: That is a good safety question. Stay aware of your surroundings, keep emergency contacts accessible and follow verified local safety guidance. Live AI-powered assistance will be available after backend integration.
